newsitem.title: MEXICO: Femsa to finalize $350 mln credit May 8.
newsitem.headline: Femsa to finalize $350 mln credit May 8.

text.p: Fomento Economico Mexicano (Femsa) said Wednesday it will finalize a $350 million syndicated loan led by Swiss Bank Corp on Thursday.
"Tomorrow Thursday, we will be closing the operation for the syndicated credit in which 23 financial institutions have participated," Alfredo Livas, Femsa's CFO, told reporters.

Livas said the new credit will be over three years and in the first year would pay interest at 1.625 percentage point over LIBOR, in the second 1.75 percentage point over and in the third 2.225 percentage points over.

"To repay this credit, we could be thinking in the long term of options such as a share issue of Femsa Cerveza (Femsa's brewing unit) or a joint ventire with Femsa Empaques (its packaging arm), but we still do not know," he added.
Swiss Bank led the loan and co-leaders were JP Morgan and ING Barings. Femsa has a $300 million Eurobond maturing on July 22.
